Bakerloo.reason: Bakerloo Line: Severe delays due to train cancellations. London Buses, Lioness Line, London Northwestern Railway and Thameslink are accepting tickets via any reasonable.

Circle.reason: Circle Line: Severe delays due to train cancellations.

District.reason: District Line: Saturday 5 and Sunday 6 September, no service between Edgware Road and Wimbledon. Rail Replacement bus services will operate. If travelling to/from Fulham vs Crystal Palace on Saturday, it may be easier to walk to/from Hammersmith.

Elizabeth line.reason: No service due to a earlier fire alert in the Paddington area. For trains to Heathrow Airport use the Piccadilly line. Tickets are being accepted by London Underground, London Buses, Thameslink, DLR, South Western Railway and Southeastern.

Metropolitan.reason: Metropolitan Line: No service between Rickmansworth and Moor Park southbound only due to a faulty train at Chesham. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Piccadilly.reason: Piccadilly Line: Severe delays between Northfields and Heathrow Terminals due to an earlier track fault in the Osterley area. MINOR DELAYS on the rest of the line due to an earlier trespasser at Hammersmith. London Underground tickets will be accepted on London buses, Weaver line, Great Northern and South Western Railway.

Victoria.reason: Victoria Line: Minor delays due to an earlier faulty train at Seven Sisters.

Waterloo & City.reason: Waterloo & City line: service operates 06:00 until 00:30, Monday to Friday only. There is no service on Saturdays, Sundays and on bank/public holidays.

Windrush.reason: WINDRUSH LINE: Saturday 5, all day, and Sunday 6 September, until 1915, no service between Surrey Quays and Clapham Junction / Battersea Park. There will also be no SOUTHERN trains at Queens Road Peckham and Peckham Rye. Replacement bus service M operates between Canada Water and Clapham Junction via Surrey Quays, Queens Road Peckham, Peckham Rye, Denmark Hill, Clapham High Street and Wandsworth Road. In addition, replacement buses operate between London Bridge and Tulse Hill via South Bermondsey, Queens Road Peckham, Peckham Rye, East Dulwich, North Dulwich and Herne Hill.
